translationPolicy.uzbekStyle: Professional, age-appropriate Uzbek; technical acronyms/keywords such as RAM, OS, MFA, SQL, IF/ELSE, AND/OR/NOT are retained where useful.
translationPolicy.principle: Translation preserves the tested construct and answer key rather than translating word-for-word.

en.context: A student finds a professional-looking website claiming that a specific exotic fruit will double a person’s memory overnight. No scientific studies are cited.
en.question: What is the best way to check this claim before believing or sharing it?

options.A: Trust the information because the website has high-quality graphics and a logo.
options.B: Check whether the same claim is reported by independent, established scientific or news sources.
options.C: Share the link immediately so others can benefit.
options.D: Assume it is true because it is the first result in a search engine.

en.explanation: Visual quality and search ranking are not evidence of truth; corroboration from independent reliable sources is stronger evidence.

uz.context: O‘quvchi professional ko‘rinadigan saytda “ma’lum bir ekzotik meva xotirani bir kechada ikki baravar kuchaytiradi” degan da’voni ko‘radi. Saytda hech qanday ilmiy tadqiqot keltirilmagan.
uz.question: Bu da’voga ishonish yoki uni ulashishdan oldin tekshirishning eng yaxshi yo‘li qaysi?

options.A: Sayt dizayni sifatli va logotipi borligi uchun ma’lumotga ishonish.
options.B: Xuddi shu da’vo mustaqil va ishonchli ilmiy yoki yangilik manbalarida ham tasdiqlanganini tekshirish.
options.C: Boshqalar ham foydalansin deb havolani darhol ulashish.
options.D: Qidiruv tizimida birinchi chiqqani uchun ma’lumotni rost deb qabul qilish.

uz.explanation: Saytning chiroyli ko‘rinishi yoki qidiruvdagi o‘rni uning to‘g‘riligini isbotlamaydi. Mustaqil va ishonchli manbalarda tasdiq bor-yo‘qligini tekshirish kuchliroq dalildir.

items.possibleFailurePattern: Deletion myth / local deletion = global deletion

en.context: Anar sends a photo to a group chat, then chooses “Delete for everyone.”
en.question: Why could someone still have a copy of the photo?

options.A: Deleting the chat message removes every copy everywhere.
options.B: A deleted photo can never be opened again.
options.C: Someone may already have downloaded it or taken a screenshot.
options.D: Photos always disappear from every device after 24 hours.

en.explanation: Digital information can persist through copies, screenshots, caches, logs, or service-provider storage even after a deletion action.

uz.context: Anar guruh chatiga surat yuboradi, keyin “Hamma uchun o‘chirish”ni tanlaydi.
uz.question: Nega suratning nusxasi baribir kimdadir qolgan bo‘lishi mumkin?

options.A: Chatdagi xabar o‘chirilsa, barcha nusxalar ham yo‘qoladi.
options.B: O‘chirilgan suratni boshqa hech qachon ochib bo‘lmaydi.
options.C: Kimdir uni oldin yuklab olgan yoki skrinshot qilgan bo‘lishi mumkin.
options.D: Suratlar 24 soatdan keyin barcha qurilmalardan o‘z-o‘zidan yo‘qoladi.

uz.explanation: Raqamli ma’lumot nusxalar, skrinshotlar, kesh, loglar yoki xizmat provayderi saqlovi orqali o‘chirishdan keyin ham mavjud bo‘lib qolishi mumkin.

en.context: You are researching “Mars” for a science project about space. Your search results are mostly about Mars-brand chocolate bars, which you do not need.
en.question: Which search strategy is the most effective way to improve your results?

options.A: Type the exact same search again.
options.B: Add “planet” or “astronomy” to the query.
options.C: Only open the first result because it must be the most relevant.
options.D: Delete browsing history and restart the computer.

en.explanation: Adding context-specific keywords narrows an ambiguous query without relying on search-engine-specific syntax.

uz.context: Siz kosmos haqidagi loyiha uchun “Mars” mavzusida qidiruv qilyapsiz. Natijalarning ko‘pi Mars nomli shokolad mahsulotlari haqida chiqmoqda.
uz.question: Qidiruv natijalarini yaxshilashning eng samarali usuli qaysi?

options.A: Xuddi shu so‘rovni yana qayta kiritish.
options.B: So‘rovga “sayyora” yoki “astronomiya” so‘zlarini qo‘shish.
options.C: Faqat birinchi natijani ochish, chunki u albatta eng mos bo‘ladi.
options.D: Brauzer tarixini o‘chirib, kompyuterni qayta ishga tushirish.

uz.explanation: Kontekstni aniqlashtiruvchi kalit so‘zlar noaniq so‘rovni toraytiradi va kerakli natijalarni topishni osonlashtiradi.

items.subCompetency: File naming conventions in collaborative environments

en.context: You are working on a group presentation called “Ecology_Project.” Your teacher wants the final folder to contain files whose version order is obvious without opening them.
en.question: Which naming convention is the most effective?

options.B: Ecology_Project_Final, Ecology_Project_Final_v2, Ecology_Project_Final_v3
options.C: Ecology_Project_v01, Ecology_Project_v02, Ecology_Project_v03

en.explanation: Sequential version numbers give an objective and unambiguous order and avoid labels such as “New” or “Final” becoming confusing.

uz.context: Siz “Ecology_Project” nomli guruh taqdimoti ustida ishlayapsiz. O‘qituvchi papkadagi fayllarning qaysi biri yangi ekanini ularni ochmasdan ham bilish mumkin bo‘lishini xohlaydi.
uz.question: Qaysi nomlash usuli eng samarali?

options.B: Ecology_Project_Final, Ecology_Project_Final_v2, Ecology_Project_Final_v3
options.C: Ecology_Project_v01, Ecology_Project_v02, Ecology_Project_v03

uz.explanation: Ketma-ket versiya raqamlari fayllarning tartibini aniq ko‘rsatadi va “New” yoki “Final” kabi tezda noaniq bo‘lib qoladigan nomlardan qochishga yordam beradi.

en.context: You find a photo online for a school charity fundraiser. The photo has a CC BY-NC license.
en.question: What does this license allow?

options.A: Use it for free as long as you do not sell the photo itself.
options.B: Use it if you credit the creator and do not use it for commercial purposes.
options.C: Use it however you want because Creative Commons means public domain.
options.D: Modify it and sell it as your own work.

en.explanation: BY requires attribution and NC restricts commercial use.

uz.context: Maktab xayriya tadbiri uchun internetdan surat topdingiz. Surat CC BY-NC litsenziyasiga ega.
uz.question: Bu litsenziya nimaga ruxsat beradi?

options.A: Suratning o‘zini sotmasangiz, undan istalgan tarzda bepul foydalanish mumkin.
options.B: Muallifni ko‘rsatish va undan tijoriy maqsadda foydalanmaslik sharti bilan ishlatish mumkin.
options.C: Creative Commons bo‘lgani uchun istalgancha foydalanish mumkin.
options.D: Suratni o‘zgartirib, o‘z ishingiz sifatida sotish mumkin.

uz.explanation: BY — muallifni ko‘rsatishni, NC esa tijoriy foydalanmaslikni talab qiladi.

en.context: A smart streetlight uses a light sensor to detect darkness and then sends a signal to turn on an LED bulb.
en.question: Which part is the Process stage of the system?

options.A: The sensor measuring the light level.
options.B: The code deciding whether the light level is low enough to switch on the lamp.
options.C: The LED bulb lighting the street.

en.explanation: In the IPO model, Process is the logical transformation or decision made using the input.

uz.context: Aqlli ko‘cha chirog‘i yorug‘lik sensori orqali qorong‘ilikni aniqlaydi va keyin LED chiroqni yoqish uchun signal yuboradi.
uz.question: Tizimning “Process” (qayta ishlash) bosqichi qaysi?

options.B: Dastur kodining yorug‘lik yetarlicha past yoki yo‘qligini aniqlab, chiroqni yoqish haqida qaror qilishi.
options.C: LED chiroqning ko‘chani yoritishi.

uz.explanation: IPO modelida “Process” — kiruvchi ma’lumot asosida bajariladigan mantiqiy qayta ishlash yoki qaror qabul qilish bosqichi.

en.context: A robot starts at (1,1). MOVE_RIGHT increases the first number by 1. MOVE_UP increases the second number by 1.
en.question: Which sequence moves it to (2,3)?

options.B: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP, MOVE_UP
options.C: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP

en.explanation: From (1,1), one RIGHT gives (2,1), then two UP commands give (2,3).

uz.context: Robot (1,1) nuqtadan boshlaydi. MOVE_RIGHT birinchi sonni 1 ga oshiradi. MOVE_UP ikkinchi sonni 1 ga oshiradi.
uz.question: Qaysi buyruqlar ketma-ketligi robotni (2,3) nuqtaga olib boradi?

options.B: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP, MOVE_UP
options.C: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP

uz.explanation: (1,1) dan bitta RIGHT → (2,1), undan keyin ikkita UP → (2,3).

en.context: A program replaces each shape using this rule: Circle → Square, Square → Triangle, Triangle → Circle.
en.question: If the input is [Circle, Triangle], what is the output?

options.B: [Triangle, Square]
options.C: [Circle, Triangle]

en.explanation: Each shape is replaced by the next in the cycle Circle → Square → Triangle → Circle.

uz.context: Dastur har bir shaklni shu qoida bo‘yicha almashtiradi: Doira → Kvadrat, Kvadrat → Uchburchak, Uchburchak → Doira.
uz.question: Kirish [Doira, Uchburchak] bo‘lsa, chiqish qanday bo‘ladi?

options.B: [Uchburchak, Kvadrat]
options.C: [Doira, Uchburchak]

uz.explanation: Har bir shakl sikldagi keyingi shaklga almashadi: Doira → Kvadrat → Uchburchak → Doira.

en.context: You are planning a New Student Orientation Day.
en.question: Which option breaks this large task into the clearest smaller jobs?

options.B: Choose only the start and end time.
options.C: Break the plan into Transport, Food/Drinks, Activity Schedule, and Budget.
options.D: Buy decorations and invite a guest speaker.

en.explanation: Decomposition means breaking a large problem into meaningful component parts that can be solved separately.

uz.context: Siz yangi o‘quvchilar uchun tanishtiruv kunini rejalashtiryapsiz.
uz.question: Qaysi variant bu katta vazifani eng tushunarli kichik ishlarga ajratadi?

options.B: Faqat boshlanish va tugash vaqtini belgilash.
options.C: Rejani Transport, Oziq-ovqat/ichimlik, Faoliyatlar jadvali va Budjet qismlariga ajratish.
options.D: Bezaklar sotib olish va mehmon taklif qilish.

uz.explanation: Decomposition — katta muammoni alohida hal qilish mumkin bo‘lgan mazmunli qismlarga ajratishdir.

en.context: You are building a simple metro map for tourists to travel between stations.
en.question: Which detail is irrelevant and should be removed to keep the map clear?

options.B: Lines connecting stations.
options.C: Exact tunnel depth underground.

en.explanation: For navigation, tunnel depth is not needed, while stations, connections, and transfers are essential.

uz.context: Sayyohlar bekatlar orasida yurishi uchun sodda metro xaritasi yaratyapsiz.
uz.question: Xaritani aniq va tushunarli saqlash uchun qaysi ma’lumot keraksiz va olib tashlanishi mumkin?

options.B: Bekatlarni bog‘lovchi yo‘nalishlar.
options.C: Tunnellarning yer ostidagi aniq chuqurligi.

uz.explanation: Yo‘l topish uchun tunnelning aniq chuqurligi kerak emas; bekatlar, bog‘lanishlar va almashuv nuqtalari esa zarur.

en.context:
Run this Python-style code from top to bottom:
X = 10
Y = 5
X = Y
Y = X
en.question: What are X and Y after the last line?
en.explanation: X ← Y overwrites X with 5. Then Y ← X copies the new X value, so both are 5.

uz.context:
Python uslubidagi kodni yuqoridan pastga bajaring:
X = 10
Y = 5
X = Y
Y = X
uz.question: Oxirgi qatordan keyin X va Y nechaga teng?
uz.explanation: X ← Y buyrug‘i X ni 5 ga o‘zgartiradi. Keyin Y ← X yangi X qiymatini Y ga nusxalaydi. Natijada ikkalasi ham 5 bo‘ladi.

en.context:
This Python code adds each number from 1 through 3:
total = 0
for number in [1, 2, 3]:
    total = total + number
en.question: What is total after the loop finishes?
en.explanation: Total becomes 1, then 3, then 6.

uz.context:
Bu Python kodi 1 dan 3 gacha bo‘lgan sonlarni qo‘shadi:
total = 0
for number in [1, 2, 3]:
    total = total + number
uz.question: Sikl tugagach, total nechaga teng bo‘ladi?
uz.explanation: Total ketma-ket 1, keyin 3, so‘ng 6 bo‘ladi.

en.context: Score ← 75; IF Score > 80 THEN Grade ← "A" ELSE Grade ← "B" ENDIF.
en.question: What is the final value of Grade?

options.B: A
options.C: B

en.explanation: 75 is not greater than 80, so the ELSE branch runs.

uz.context: Score ← 75; IF Score > 80 THEN Grade ← "A" ELSE Grade ← "B" ENDIF.
uz.question: Grade ning yakuniy qiymati nima bo‘ladi?

options.B: A
options.C: B

uz.explanation: 75 soni 80 dan katta emas, shuning uchun ELSE tarmog‘i bajariladi.

en.context:
A library allows borrowing only when both rules are met:
1. All earlier books were returned.
2. The fine is below $5 OR the student is in a senior grade.
en.question: Which student meets both rules?

options.A: Returned all books; $10 fine; not in a senior grade.
options.B: Did not return all books; no fine; in a senior grade.
options.C: Returned all books; $2 fine; not in a senior grade.
options.D: Did not return all books; $10 fine; in a senior grade.

en.explanation: The student must have returned the books and also satisfy either Fine<5 or Is_Senior=TRUE.

uz.context:
Kutubxonadan kitob olish uchun ikkala qoida ham bajarilishi kerak:
1. Oldingi kitoblarning barchasi qaytarilgan.
2. Jarima 5 dollardan kam YOKI o‘quvchi yuqori sinfda o‘qiydi.
uz.question: Qaysi o‘quvchi ikkala qoidaga ham mos keladi?

options.A: Barcha kitoblarni qaytargan; jarima 10 dollar; yuqori sinfda emas.
options.B: Barcha kitoblarni qaytarmagan; jarima yo‘q; yuqori sinfda.
options.C: Barcha kitoblarni qaytargan; jarima 2 dollar; yuqori sinfda emas.
options.D: Barcha kitoblarni qaytarmagan; jarima 10 dollar; yuqori sinfda.

uz.explanation: O‘quvchi avvalo kitoblarni qaytargan bo‘lishi va qo‘shimcha ravishda jarima 5 dan kichik YOKI Is_Senior=TRUE shartlaridan birini bajarishi kerak.

en.context: A program accepts ages 13 to 19 inclusive.
en.question: Which set is the best boundary test data?
en.explanation: Boundary testing checks values at the limits and immediately outside them.

uz.context: Dastur 13 dan 19 gacha bo‘lgan yoshlarni, chegaralar bilan birga, qabul qiladi.
uz.question: Qaysi qiymatlar to‘plami eng yaxshi chegaraviy test (boundary test) ma’lumotidir?
uz.explanation: Chegaraviy test diapazon chegaralaridagi va ulardan bevosita tashqaridagi qiymatlarni tekshiradi.

en.context: A student types three paragraphs but does not save them. The power goes out and the paragraphs disappear.
en.question: Which component was most likely holding the missing text before power loss?

options.B: Hard drive / SSD
options.C: ROM

en.explanation: RAM is volatile working memory; unsaved data in RAM is lost when power is removed.

uz.context: O‘quvchi uchta paragraf yozadi, lekin hali saqlamaydi. Elektr o‘chib, matn yo‘qoladi.
uz.question: Elektr o‘chishidan oldin saqlanmagan matn qaysi komponentda turgan bo‘lishi ehtimol?

options.B: Qattiq disk / SSD
options.C: ROM

uz.explanation: RAM — vaqtinchalik (volatile) ishchi xotira. Elektr uzilganda undagi saqlanmagan ma’lumot yo‘qoladi.

en.context: A large video file is sent over the internet after being split into many packets.
en.question: Which statement is true?

options.A: All packets must travel along the same path.
options.B: Packets may take different routes and arrive in a different order.
options.C: If one packet is lost, the file is permanently unreadable.
options.D: Packets are merged into one giant block before entering the internet.

en.explanation: Packet-switched networks can route packets independently and reassemble them at the destination.

uz.context: Katta video fayl internet orqali yuborilishidan oldin ko‘plab paketlarga bo‘linadi.
uz.question: Qaysi fikr to‘g‘ri?

options.A: Barcha paketlar bir xil yo‘ldan borishi shart.
options.B: Paketlar turli yo‘llardan borishi va yuborilgan tartibdan boshqa tartibda yetib kelishi mumkin.
options.C: Bitta paket yo‘qolsa, fayl butunlay tiklab bo‘lmaydigan holga keladi.
options.D: Paketlar internetga kirishdan oldin yana bitta katta blokka birlashtiriladi.

uz.explanation: Paketli tarmoqda paketlar mustaqil yo‘nalishlardan borishi va manzilda qayta yig‘ilishi mumkin.

en.context: You receive an urgent email from security-support@yourbank-update.net saying your account will be deleted in 2 hours unless you click a link and log in.
en.question: What is the safest first step?

options.B: Reply and ask for proof.
options.C: Ignore the link and open the bank’s official site by typing its address yourself.
options.D: Download the attachment to read the safety policy.

en.explanation: Using the independently known official site avoids interacting with the potentially malicious link or sender.

uz.context: Siz security-support@yourbank-update.net manzilidan “2 soat ichida havolaga kirib hisobga kirmasangiz, akkauntingiz o‘chiriladi” degan shoshilinch xat olasiz.
uz.question: Eng xavfsiz birinchi qadam qaysi?

options.B: Xatga javob berib, haqiqiyligini isbotlashni so‘rash.
options.C: Havolani bosmasdan, bankning rasmiy sayt manzilini o‘zingiz kiritib ochish.
options.D: “Xavfsizlik siyosati”ni o‘qish uchun ilovani yuklab olish.

uz.explanation: Rasmiy saytni mustaqil ravishda ochish shubhali havola yoki yuboruvchi bilan bevosita ishlashdan qochadi.

en.context: A computer has different types of software installed.
en.question: What is the primary role of the Operating System (OS)?

options.A: Help users write essays and spreadsheets.
options.B: Manage hardware and provide a platform for applications to run.
options.C: Browse the internet and send emails.

en.explanation: The OS manages hardware/resources and provides services on which applications run.

uz.context: Kompyuterda turli xil dasturlar o‘rnatilgan.
uz.question: Operatsion tizimning (OS) asosiy vazifasi nima?

options.A: Insho yozish va elektron jadval tuzishga yordam berish.
options.B: Qurilmalarni boshqarish va boshqa ilovalar ishlashi uchun platforma yaratish.
options.C: Internetda ko‘rish va elektron pochta yuborish.

uz.explanation: Operatsion tizim qurilma va resurslarni boshqaradi hamda ilovalar ishlashi uchun asos yaratadi.

en.context: A login asks for a password and then a code sent to the user’s phone.
en.question: Why is this safer than a password alone?

options.A: It makes the password impossible to forget.
options.B: It guarantees the internet connection is encrypted.
options.C: An attacker would need both the secret knowledge and access to the physical device.

en.explanation: The system uses two different authentication factors: something you know and something you have.

uz.context: Tizim avval parolni, keyin esa foydalanuvchining telefoniga yuborilgan kodni so‘raydi.
uz.question: Nega bu usul faqat paroldan ko‘ra xavfsizroq?

options.B: Internet ulanishini albatta shifrlaydi.
options.C: Hujumchi ham maxfiy ma’lumotni, ham jismoniy qurilmaga kirishni qo‘lga kiritishi kerak bo‘ladi.

uz.explanation: Bu yerda ikki xil autentifikatsiya omili ishlatiladi: siz biladigan narsa va sizda mavjud bo‘lgan narsa.

en.context: You are building a student database for a school with 1,000 students.
en.question: Which field is the best Primary Key?

options.B: Student_Birth_Date
options.C: Student_ID_Number

en.explanation: A primary key must uniquely identify each record; names, birth dates, and cities can repeat.

uz.context: 1 000 o‘quvchili maktab uchun o‘quvchilar bazasini yaratyapsiz.
uz.question: Qaysi maydon Primary Key (asosiy kalit) uchun eng yaxshi tanlov?

options.B: Student_Birth_Date
options.C: Student_ID_Number

uz.explanation: Primary Key har bir yozuvni yagona tarzda ajratishi kerak. Ism, tug‘ilgan sana yoki shahar takrorlanishi mumkin.

en.context: A sensor records daily temperatures: [15, 12, -99, 14, 16]. You need the average.
en.question: How should you handle -99?

options.A: Include it because all sensor readings are accurate.
options.B: Change it to 0 without investigation.
options.C: Remove or investigate it because it is likely an outlier/sensor error.

en.explanation: An implausible value should be investigated before it distorts analysis.

uz.context: Sensor kunlik haroratlarni yozdi: [15, 12, -99, 14, 16]. Siz o‘rtacha qiymatni hisoblamoqchisiz.
uz.question: -99 qiymati bilan nima qilish kerak?

options.A: Barcha sensor ma’lumotlari to‘g‘ri deb hisoblab, uni ham qo‘shish.
options.B: Tekshirmasdan 0 ga almashtirish.
options.C: U ehtimol chet qiymat yoki sensor xatosi bo‘lgani uchun uni tekshirish yoki vaqtincha chiqarib tashlash.
options.D: Qolgan barcha qiymatlarni ham -99 ga almashtirish.

uz.explanation: Mantiqan shubhali qiymat tahlilni buzmasligi uchun avval tekshirilishi kerak.

en.context: An Integer stores whole numbers only. A school system stores absences, student ID, and exam score as Integers. An exam score can be 85.5.
en.question: Which value could lose its decimal part?

options.B: Student ID
options.C: Exam score

en.explanation: Integer stores whole numbers, so a value such as 85.5 requires a Real/Float representation.

uz.context: Integer faqat butun sonlarni saqlaydi. Maktab tizimi dars qoldirish soni, o‘quvchi ID raqami va imtihon balini Integer sifatida saqlaydi. Imtihon bali 85.5 bo‘lishi mumkin.
uz.question: Qaysi qiymatning kasr qismi yo‘qolishi mumkin?

options.B: O‘quvchi ID raqami
options.C: Imtihon bali

uz.explanation: Integer faqat butun sonlarni saqlaydi. 85.5 kabi qiymat uchun Real/Float kerak.

en.context: Cell C1 contains =A1+B1. You copy the formula to C2.
en.question: What does the formula become?
en.explanation: Relative references move with the copied formula, so row 1 becomes row 2.

uz.context: C1 katagida =A1+B1 formulasi bor. Siz formulani C2 katagiga nusxalaysiz.
uz.question: Formula qanday o‘zgaradi?
uz.explanation: Nisbiy (relative) havolalar formula bilan birga siljiydi, shuning uchun 1-qator 2-qatorga o‘zgaradi.

en.context: You type your new email address twice into a form to make sure you did not mistype it.
en.question: Which process is this?

options.B: Verification (double entry)
options.C: Data mining

en.explanation: Double entry is verification: it checks whether entered data matches the intended/original value, not whether it satisfies a format rule.

uz.context: Siz yangi elektron pochta manzilingizni xato kiritmaganligingizga ishonch hosil qilish uchun formaga ikki marta yozasiz.
uz.question: Bu qaysi jarayon?

options.B: Verification (ikki marta kiritib solishtirish)
options.C: Data mining

uz.explanation: Ikki marta kiritish — verification. U kiritilgan ma’lumotning asl/ko‘zlangan qiymatga mosligini tekshiradi, format qoidalariga mosligini emas.

en.context: A bank uses AI to review student loan applications and wants the process to remain responsible and fair.
en.question: How should the bank use AI while keeping a person responsible for the final decision?

options.A: Let AI make the final decision automatically.
options.B: Use AI to flag risks, but require a bank employee to review and make the final decision.
options.C: Do not allow appeals because AI is objective.
options.D: Hide the AI reasoning so the bank cannot be blamed.

en.explanation: In high-stakes decisions, humans should retain oversight and accountability.

uz.context: Bank talaba kredit arizalarini ko‘rib chiqishda AI dan foydalanadi va jarayon mas’uliyatli hamda adolatli bo‘lishini xohlaydi.
uz.question: Yakuniy qaror uchun inson javobgar bo‘lib qolishi uchun bank AI’dan qanday foydalanishi kerak?

options.A: Yakuniy qarorni AI ga to‘liq avtomatik qoldirish.
options.B: AI xavfli holatlarni belgilaydi, lekin bank xodimi ularni ko‘rib chiqib yakuniy qarorni qabul qiladi.
options.C: AI xolis bo‘lgani uchun apellyatsiyaga ruxsat bermaslik.
options.D: Bank javobgar bo‘lmasligi uchun AI qarorining sabablarini yashirish.

uz.explanation: Yuqori xavfli qarorlarda inson nazorati va yakuniy javobgarlik saqlanib qolishi kerak.

en.context: You ask a chatbot who won the World Cup in 1925. It answers “Uruguay,” even though the first World Cup was in 1930.
en.question: Why did the chatbot likely produce this wrong answer?

options.B: It generated a likely-sounding answer from learned language patterns even though the event never happened.
options.C: It is connected to a verified live database of every sports event.
options.D: A sports fan programmed that exact false answer.

en.explanation: Generative AI can produce fluent but false content by predicting plausible language patterns rather than verifying every fact.

uz.context: Siz chatbotdan “1925-yilgi Jahon chempionatida kim g‘olib bo‘lgan?” deb so‘raysiz. U “Urugvay” deb javob beradi, aslida birinchi Jahon chempionati 1930-yilda bo‘lgan.
uz.question: Chatbot nega bunday noto‘g‘ri javob bergan bo‘lishi mumkin?

options.B: U voqea bo‘lmagan bo‘lsa ham, o‘rgangan til naqshlari asosida ishonarli eshitiladigan javob yaratgan.
options.C: U barcha sport voqealarining tekshirilgan jonli bazasiga ulangan.
options.D: Bir sport muxlisi aynan shu yolg‘on javobni dasturlab qo‘ygan.

uz.explanation: Generativ AI har bir faktni tekshirmasdan, ehtimoliy til naqshlari asosida ravon, lekin noto‘g‘ri javob yaratishi mumkin.

en.context: You ask an AI chatbot “Explain how a computer works.” It returns a 2,000-word answer full of jargon you do not understand.
en.question: Which follow-up is most effective?

options.A: Paste the same long answer back into the prompt.
options.B: Say “That was too hard; try again.”
options.C: Say “Summarize this into 3 bullet points for a Grade 8 student using simple analogies.”
options.D: Switch tools and repeat the same original question.

en.explanation: The best follow-up adds explicit constraints for length, audience, and style.

uz.context: Siz AI chatbotga “Kompyuter qanday ishlashini tushuntir” deysiz. U 2 000 so‘zli, murakkab texnik atamalarga boy javob beradi.
uz.question: Qaysi keyingi so‘rov eng samarali?

options.A: Xuddi shu uzun javobni promptga qayta joylashtirish.
options.B: “Bu juda qiyin edi, yaxshiroq tushuntir” deb yozish.
options.C: “Buni 8-sinf o‘quvchisi uchun sodda o‘xshatishlardan foydalanib 3 ta punktda qisqacha tushuntir” deb yozish.
options.D: Boshqa AI vositasiga o‘tib, aynan o‘sha dastlabki savolni takrorlash.

uz.explanation: Eng yaxshi keyingi prompt uzunlik, auditoriya va uslub bo‘yicha aniq cheklovlar beradi.

en.context: A facial-recognition AI is trained using 100,000 photos of adults. It then fails to recognize children aged 10–12.
en.question: What is the most likely reason?

options.A: The AI intentionally decided children are unauthorized.
options.B: The training photos did not include enough children, so the AI did not learn to recognize their faces well.
options.C: The entire program must be rewritten in another programming language.
options.D: The camera automatically turns off for short people.

en.explanation: Model reliability depends on whether training data represents the cases it will encounter.

uz.context: Yuzni tanish AI tizimi 100 000 ta kattalar suratida o‘qitilgan. Keyin u 10–12 yoshli bolalarni taniy olmaydi.
uz.question: Eng ehtimoliy sabab nima?

options.A: AI ataylab bolalarni ruxsatsiz deb qaror qilgan.
options.B: O‘rgatish uchun ishlatilgan suratlarda bolalar yetarli bo‘lmagan, shuning uchun AI ularning yuzini yaxshi tanishni o‘rganmagan.
options.C: Dastur boshqa dasturlash tilida boshidan yozilishi kerak.
options.D: Kamera bo‘yi past odamlarni ko‘rganda avtomatik o‘chadi.

uz.explanation: Modelning ishonchliligi trening ma’lumotlari real foydalanishdagi holatlarni qanchalik yaxshi ifodalashiga bog‘liq.

en.context: A large organization wants to use AI only where it is appropriate and low-risk.
en.question: Which task is the most appropriate and proportionate use of AI?

options.A: Filter 10,000 incoming emails per hour to flag obvious spam.
options.B: Make the final legal sentence for a convicted person.
options.C: Automatically interview and hire a school principal.
options.D: Perform complex heart surgery without any human doctor present.

en.explanation: Spam filtering is high-volume and comparatively low-risk; the other options delegate high-stakes human judgment or safety-critical responsibility.

uz.context: Katta tashkilot AI dan faqat mos va xavfi nisbatan past vazifalarda foydalanmoqchi.
uz.question: Qaysi vazifa AI dan eng maqbul va mutanosib foydalanish hisoblanadi?

options.A: Soatiga 10 000 ta kiruvchi xatni tahlil qilib, aniq spam xatlarni belgilash.
options.B: Jinoyat sodir etgan shaxsga yakuniy sud jazosi tayinlash.
options.C: Maktab direktorini avtomatik suhbatdan o‘tkazib, ishga olish.
options.D: Hech qanday shifokorsiz murakkab yurak operatsiyasini bajarish.

uz.explanation: Spam filtrlash katta hajmli va nisbatan past xavfli vazifa. Qolgan variantlar yuqori xavfli insoniy hukm yoki xavfsizlik mas’uliyatini AI ga topshiradi.

en.context: You see a polished website claiming a famous athlete quit today, but no other news source reports it.
en.question: Why should you be careful before believing it?

options.B: The athlete might change their mind later.
options.C: High-quality design does not prove the claim is true.
options.D: News websites are not allowed to use animations.

en.explanation: Design quality is not evidence of factual accuracy.

uz.context: Siz professional ko‘rinadigan saytda mashhur sportchi bugun faoliyatini tugatgani haqidagi xabarni ko‘rasiz, lekin boshqa yangilik manbalarida bu haqda xabar yo‘q.
uz.question: Nega bu xabarga darhol ishonmaslik kerak?

options.A: Professional ko‘rinadigan saytlar hech qachon xato qilmaydi.
options.B: Sportchi keyin fikrini o‘zgartirishi mumkin.
options.C: Sayt dizayni sifatli bo‘lishi xabarning rostligini isbotlamaydi.
options.D: Yangilik saytlariga animatsiya ishlatish mumkin emas.

uz.explanation: Saytning ko‘rinishi faktning to‘g‘riligini isbotlamaydi.

en.context: You send a photo to a friend, then delete it from your own phone gallery.
en.question: Is the photo now completely gone from the internet?

options.A: Yes, deleting the original removes every copy.
options.B: No; the friend may have saved it or the service may still have a copy.
options.C: Yes, the Delete button is a legal guarantee of complete removal.
options.D: No, but it will always disappear automatically after 24 hours.

en.explanation: Local deletion does not guarantee that all remote or copied versions disappear.

uz.context: Siz do‘stingizga surat yuborasiz, keyin uni o‘z telefoningiz galereyasidan o‘chirasiz.
uz.question: Surat endi internetdan butunlay yo‘qoldimi?

options.A: Ha, asl faylni o‘chirish barcha nusxalarni ham yo‘q qiladi.
options.B: Yo‘q; do‘stingiz uni saqlagan bo‘lishi yoki xizmatda nusxasi qolgan bo‘lishi mumkin.
options.C: Ha, “Delete” tugmasi to‘liq o‘chirishning huquqiy kafolatidir.
options.D: Yo‘q, lekin u har doim 24 soatdan keyin avtomatik yo‘qoladi.

uz.explanation: Mahalliy o‘chirish masofadagi yoki nusxalangan barcha versiyalar yo‘qolishini kafolatlamaydi.

en.context: You want to find the height of the Kalyan Minaret in Bukhara.
en.question: Which search query is most likely to give the exact number quickly?

options.A: Tell me everything about beautiful Bukhara and its towers.
options.B: Kalyan Minaret height
options.C: Where is the Kalyan Minaret located?

en.explanation: A short query that directly expresses the information need is the most precise.

uz.context: Siz Buxorodagi Kalon minorasining balandligini topmoqchisiz.
uz.question: Qaysi qidiruv so‘rovi aniq raqamni tezroq topishga yordam beradi?

options.A: Go‘zal Buxoro va undagi minoralar haqida hammasini aytib ber.
options.B: Kalon minorasi balandligi
options.C: Kalon minorasi qayerda joylashgan?

uz.explanation: Aniq axborot ehtiyojini bevosita ifodalagan qisqa so‘rov eng samarali.

en.context: Inside a folder named School, you create a folder named Math. Inside Math, you save Homework.pdf.
en.question: Where is Homework.pdf located?

options.A: Only in Math, unrelated to School.
options.B: Only in School, not in Math.
options.C: In Math, which is inside School.
options.D: Saved twice, once in each folder.

en.explanation: The file is inside the nested Math folder, and Math itself is inside School.

uz.question: Homework.pdf qayerda joylashgan?

options.A: Faqat Math papkasida, School bilan bog‘liq emas.

options.C: School ichidagi Math papkasida.

en.context: You find an image through a public search engine and can view it without a password.
en.question: Does that automatically mean you may use it as your own?

options.A: Yes, search-engine results are public domain.
options.B: No; you may still need permission or a license from the creator.
options.C: Yes, digital information cannot be owned.
options.D: Only images with a “Do Not Copy” sign are protected.

en.explanation: Being publicly viewable does not remove copyright or licensing conditions.

options.D: Saving the data to a file.

en.explanation: Input is the data entering the system from the environment.

options.A: Yes, because the display name says Principal.

options.A: U tekshirilgan faktlar bazasidan haqiqiy yashil mushukni topgan bo‘lishi kerak.
options.B: U trening davomida o‘rgangan naqshlar asosida ehtimoliy so‘zlar ketma-ketligini yaratishi mumkin; tasvirlangan narsa real bo‘lishi shart emas.
options.C: Kompyuter ichidagi kichkina odam hikoyani yozadi.
options.D: Avval internetdan yashil mushuk suratini topishi shart.

uz.explanation: Generativ model o‘rgangan naqshlar asosida ishonarli matn tuzishi mumkin; matn yaratish tekshirilgan faktni qidirib topish bilan bir xil emas.

en.context: You want an AI to write a short, kind birthday poem for your mother.
en.question: Which prompt is most useful?

options.B: Birthday.
options.C: Write a happy and kind 4-line birthday poem for my mother.

en.explanation: The prompt clearly specifies task, audience/topic, tone, and length.

uz.context: Siz AI dan onangiz uchun qisqa va mehribon tug‘ilgan kun she’ri yozishni xohlaysiz.
uz.question: Qaysi prompt eng foydali?

options.B: Tug‘ilgan kun.
options.C: Onamning tug‘ilgan kuni uchun quvnoq va mehribon 4 qatorli she’r yoz.

uz.explanation: Bu prompt vazifa, mavzu, uslub va uzunlikni aniq ko‘rsatadi.

en.context: An AI is trained to recognize “fruit” using only 100 photos of red apples and no other fruit.
en.question: What is the main risk when it sees a yellow banana?

options.A: It will always recognize it correctly because AI is smart.
options.B: It may fail because its training examples do not represent bananas or varied fruit.
options.C: It will ask you to buy a banana.
options.D: It will learn bananas automatically by looking at sunlight.

en.explanation: Poorly representative training data can cause poor generalization to unseen categories.

uz.context: AI “meva”ni tanish uchun faqat 100 ta qizil olma suratida o‘qitilgan, boshqa mevalar yo‘q.
uz.question: U sariq bananni ko‘rganda asosiy xavf nima?

options.A: AI aqlli bo‘lgani uchun uni har doim to‘g‘ri taniydi.
options.B: Trening misollarida banan va boshqa turdagi mevalar yo‘qligi sababli uni tanimasligi mumkin.
options.C: U sizdan banan sotib olishingizni so‘raydi.

uz.explanation: Yetarlicha vakillik qilmagan trening ma’lumotlari yangi toifalarga yomon umumlashtirishga olib kelishi mumkin.

en.context: You need to calculate 2+2.
en.question: Is a large energy-intensive AI system the appropriate tool?

options.B: No; a simple calculator is sufficient, reliable, faster, and much less resource-intensive.
options.C: Yes, AI may give a more creative answer than 4.
options.D: No, AI is not allowed to do mathematics.

en.explanation: Proportionality means choosing a simpler non-AI solution when it meets the need with lower cost/risk/resource use.

uz.context: Siz 2+2 ni hisoblamoqchisiz.
uz.question: Buning uchun katta va ko‘p energiya sarflaydigan AI tizimidan foydalanish maqbulmi?

options.B: Yo‘q; oddiy kalkulyator yetarli, ishonchli, tez va ancha kam resurs sarflaydi.
options.C: Ha, AI 4 dan ijodiyroq javob berishi mumkin.
options.D: Yo‘q, AI ga matematika qilish mumkin emas.

uz.explanation: Mutanosiblik tamoyili oddiyroq vosita ehtiyojni kamroq xarajat, xavf va resurs bilan bajarsa, o‘sha vositani tanlashni anglatadi.
